Dr. Tomas Streyer stood in the control room with a team of scientists and engineers,
filled with a mix of excitement and fear. They were about to start an experiment to understand
the beginnings of the universe. Tomas looked at the clear sky before beginning the experiment
and then activated the particle accelerator bencath Switzerland. Little did he know that this
would lead to monumental consequences.
When Tomas pressed the final button, the control room was suddenly engulfed in
darkness. For a moment, he was confused and unsure of what had happened. When the lights
returned, everything seemed normal, and the particle accelerator was working as expected.
However, outside, the bright summer sky had turned into an endless black void, with no sun,
moon, or stars. Panic spread as people tried to contact their loved ones, fearing they had
disappeared too.
Tomas and his team joined the worried crowd outside, using their phones and car
headlights to light up the darkened area. After twenty minutes of darkness, the sun reappeared,
bringing relief and joy. But when night came, the sky was empty, with no stars visible. This
strange event left the world in fear and confusion, and Tomas found himself at the centre of the
controversy.
As days passed, the media blamed Tomas for the disappearance of the stars,
sensationalising the event. People did not care about the science behind the experiment and
only saw Tomas as the one who "stole" the stars. When he was brought before the International
Criminal Court, Tomas insisted that he was innocent and that the experiment had not been
meant to cause such a problem. But the public and the prosecution demanded answers, and
Tomas struggled to explain the complex science involved.
In court, Tomas' explanations about photons and the nature of light were too difficult
for the audience to understand. The lawyer's tough questions made Tomas feel like he was
being unfairly blamed for something he didn't intend to happen. In a moment of defeat, Tomas
decided to admit guilty, not because he was truly guilty, but because he wanted to give the
world a sense of closure by having someone to blame.
Instead of being sent to prison, Tomas was assigned to work at the Extremely Large
Telescope in Chile, a once-busy place that had now become quiet. This new job felt like a
punishment, as the lonely telescope mirrored his isolation. Every night, Tomas looked at the
empty sky, thinking about the mystery he had accidentally created. The sunsets gave him some
comfort, knowing that the laws of physics still held, but he felt alone as the world slowly forgot
him.

For four and a half years, Tomas kept watching the same empty sky. He thought about
the darkness he had unleashed, imagining it spreading through the universe. He wondered if
one day the stars' light would return to Earth, hoping for some sign of hope. Then, on the
1,596th night, Tomas saw something incredible: Alpha Centauri, the first star, reappeared in
the sky. Overcome with emotion, Tomas made a wish, feeling connected to others who might
be wishing on the same star. In that moment, the darkness in his life began to fade, replaced by
a flicker of hope.

Technology today has changed how we live, work, and communicate in many ways.
New devices like smartphones and advanced technology like artificial intelligence (AI) are
improving our daily lives and shaping our future.
One of the biggest advancements is Al and machine learning. These technologies are
used in many areas like healthcare, finance, and transportation. 27. [ For example, in
healthcare, AT helps doctors diagnose diseases, create personalized treatment plans, and assist
in surgeries with great accuracy. This means patients can get better and faster care.
Another important development is the Internet of Things (lo1). This technology connects
everyday objects to the internet, allowing them to collect and share data. 28.
In industries, loT improves productivity and safety by monitoring equipment performance and
predicting maintenance needs. This helps prevent breakdowns and accidents, making
workplaces safer and more efficient.
High-speed internet and mobile connectivity have also transformed communication and
information sharing. 29. This connectivity has made remote work and online
education possible, providing flexibility and access to resources from anywhere in the world.
Students can attend classes online, and employees can work from home, saving time and money
on travel.
Blockchain technology, known for cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin, is also making an
impact. It offers secure and transparent transactions, with potential uses in finance, supply
chain management, and voting systems. 30.
However, rapid technological advancements also bring challenges. Privacy,
cybersecurity, and the ethical use of Al are important concerns. 31. L We need to make
sure everyone can benefit from these advancements and that personal data is protected.
In conclusion, technology today is transforming society in many ways. 32. [
Balancing innovation with ethical considerations is key to using technology effectively for a
better future. As we navigate this digital era, we must ensure that these technologies are used
responsibly and for the good of all people.
